summary: iter-221 / v62.6 'PAMM Risk Truth & Production Gate' P0 HTTP + direct-guard E2E verification. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter221_risk_truth_http.py with 11 pytest.mark.http tests covering ALL 10 previously-untested v62.6 scenarios from the review. RESULT: 11/11 PASSED in ~6s. Regression re-run (iter216 30 + iter217 36 + iter218 22 + iter220 12): 100/100 PASSED in ~30s. Scenario coverage: R1 LIVE governed CERTIFIED program + unset current_spreads/spreads_updated_at + delete last_nav and pamm_nav_snapshots -> guard REJECTS reason='risk_unknown' with detail.missing_required_evidence containing both drawdown_pct and spread_pips, state='RISK_UNKNOWN'. R2 LIVE full evidence + $unset program.position_truth -> reject 'position_truth_missing'. R3 LIVE full evidence + position_truth.at = 20 min ago (sniper latency_sensitivity=HIGH => 600s window) -> reject 'position_truth_stale' with detail.age_s > detail.max_age_s. R4 LIVE full FRESH evidence -> authorized=True, mode='STRATEGY', context.risk_snapshot_id starts with 'rds_'; pamm_risk_decisions has doc with matching snapshot_id, authorized=True, environment='LIVE', reason='authorized', envelope+telemetry+checks populated, and every REQUIRED_TELEMETRY key (open_positions, open_risk_pct_sum, daily_loss_pct, weekly_loss_pct, drawdown_pct, spread_pips) resolved to a non-None value. R5 DEMO controlled profile (max_weekly_loss=5.0), balance=10k, seed 2 closed trades Monday-01:00 pnl=-300 each -> reject 'weekly_loss_cap_reached' (6% >= 5%). R6 seed pamm_nav_snapshots peak=10000, program.last_nav.nav=8000 -> reject 'drawdown_cap_reached' (20% >= 10%). R7a fresh current_spreads[EURUSD]=5.0, spreads_updated_at=now -> reject 'spread_cap_exceeded' (5.0 > 2.0). R7b stale spreads (spreads_updated_at 2h ago) on DEMO -> telemetry.spread_pips STAYS None, guard PASSES; verified via pamm_risk_decisions.telemetry.spread_pips is None (violation not fabricated). R8 controlled max_factor_exposure=2.0, seed open GBPUSD 1.9 lots + new EURUSD 0.2 lot signal -> reject 'factor_exposure_exceeded' with detail.factor='USD', proposed_lots > 2.0. R9 controlled max_slippage_pips=1.0, seed 3 closed trades with slippage_checked=True, slippage_pips=(2.0, 3.0, 2.5) -> median > 1.0 -> reject 'expected_slippage_exceeded' with recent_median_slippage_pips > max_slippage_pips. R10 same weekly_loss reject setup with pre-run pamm_risk_decisions clean, then verify pamm_risk_decisions has doc where authorized=False, reason='weekly_loss_cap_reached', environment='DEMO', snapshot_id starts with 'rds_', envelope+telemetry+checks populated. All 11 tests use asyncio.new_event_loop() per direct guard call, motor client isolated per-call (matches iter218/iter220 pattern). LIVE tests share ONE class-scoped certified program (amortises the ~15-30s walk_to_certified across the 4 LIVE-only scenarios via a class fixture + autouse _reset_evidence fixture that re-seeds fresh risk-truth and clears pamm_risk_decisions between tests). Cleanup verified post-run: 0 residual iter221 programs, accounts, or trades.
critical_code_review_comments: authorize_pamm_strategy_execution wraps _authorize and persists a COMPLETE Effective Risk Decision Snapshot for EVERY governed decision (authorized AND rejected) — verified R4 and R10 both write documents with envelope/telemetry/checks intact, and only when authorized does it inject context.risk_snapshot_id. This makes rejected decisions fully auditable, matching v62.6 spec.

missing_required_telemetry() correctly enumerates ONLY the 6 REQUIRED keys (open_positions, open_risk_pct_sum, daily_loss_pct, weekly_loss_pct, drawdown_pct, spread_pips) — optional telemetry (factor_lots, consecutive_losses, recent_slippage_pips, symbol_open_lots) intentionally never triggers RISK_UNKNOWN. Confirmed by R1: after unsetting only spread + NAV evidence, missing_required is exactly ['drawdown_pct', 'spread_pips'] (open_positions/open_risk_pct_sum are always computed; daily/weekly_loss_pct fall back to 0 whenever balance is known).

Spread telemetry never fabricates: R7b confirms that on DEMO with stale spreads_updated_at, telemetry.spread_pips stays None and envelope_violations DOES NOT include spread_cap_exceeded — the 'never fabricate a violation from missing evidence' invariant holds end-to-end.

Freshness table is strategy-aware: sniper is HIGH -> spread_s=60, position_truth_s=600. R3 uses 20 min old position_truth = 1200s > 600s -> stale reject fires. If a nitro_scalper is used the window would be 300s (MAXIMUM), so the same 20-min stale would also fire but faster edge cases (5-10 min) would only trip on nitro not sniper. Good latency-differentiated design.

envelope_violations returns EARLY on the first matching violation (guard rejects on vio[0]). Order in the function matters: symbol_not_allowed -> risk_cap -> max_open_positions -> symbol_exposure -> daily_loss -> consecutive_losses -> weekly_loss -> drawdown -> spread -> slippage -> factor. A signal that trips multiple caps only reports the FIRST — the pamm_risk_decisions snapshot captures the full telemetry+envelope so an operator can still see the others.

The pamm_risk_decisions insert is wrapped in a try/except (TypeError, AttributeError) to tolerate isolated unit-test DB mocks (line 396). This is correct for the unit path but silently swallows any REAL insertion failure in prod (e.g. duplicate key on snapshot_id, mongo unavailable). Suggestion (non-blocking): log at WARNING level in the except branch so silent data loss is observable.

resolve_program falls back to master_account_id -> pamm_programs lookup when the signal doesn't carry program_id. R4-R10 all rely on this — a signal from a manual trade route doesn't need to pre-resolve the program. Elegant.

The factor_exposure check breaks on FIRST factor violation (line 206) — for symbols like XAUUSD where both XAU and USD may hit limits, only the first is reported. Verified in R8: signal is EURUSD (factors [EUR, USD]) — EUR proposed 0.2 (ok), USD proposed 2.1 (violation, break). The order is signal-symbol-alpha-order which is deterministic.

Suggestion (non-blocking): recent_slippage_pips uses trades.slippage_checked=True + slippage_pips!=None sorted by created_at DESC LIMIT 10 median. There's no timestamp cutoff (e.g. 'last 24h'), so a stale month-old measurement can still veto a new trade if the last 10 are all stale. Consider adding a bounded-lookback window for recent_slippage_pips semantics.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter221_risk_truth_http.py is the canonical HTTP+direct-guard regression for v62.6 PAMM Risk Truth. Gotchas: (1) On LIVE, sniper needs BOTH a valid kind:'system' cert on the account AND a certified/canary strategy campaign — seed both via _seed_system_cert() + _walk_to_certified(). (2) The v62.6 RISK_UNKNOWN gate only applies on LIVE (env_name=='LIVE'); DEMO tests can freely enforce envelope caps (weekly/drawdown/factor/slippage/spread-when-fresh) without seeding evidence. (3) position_truth checks (missing/stale) ONLY run on LIVE, AFTER risk_unknown gate; on DEMO you cannot reproduce them. (4) sniper latency_sensitivity='HIGH' -> position_truth_s=600, spread_s=60. If you need stale-detection at longer windows use nitro_scalper (MAXIMUM -> 300s). (5) LIVE class-scoped fixture uses one program and re-seeds risk truth between tests to save 15-30s per test on the certification walk. (6) pamm_risk_decisions accumulates docs from ALL runs since it isn't indexed for cleanup by test-suffix — _cleanup_program only deletes by program_id (which is enough for iter221). If DB residuals accumulate, run `db.pamm_risk_decisions.delete_many({'at': {'$lt': '<cutoff>'}})`.
rca of the issue: No new bug found — all v62.6 P0 semantics work as specified. R1-R4 confirm the LIVE risk-unknown/position-truth gate is properly wired ahead of envelope_violations. R5-R9 confirm every new envelope key (max_weekly_loss_pct, max_drawdown_pct, max_spread_pips, max_factor_exposure_lots, max_slippage_pips) resolves via effective_envelope() and fires the correct reject reason. R7b explicitly guards the 'never fabricate a violation on missing/stale evidence' invariant on DEMO. R10 confirms rejected decisions ALSO write to pamm_risk_decisions (not just authorized ones). Snapshot doc structure (envelope+telemetry+checks+reason+snapshot_id) is complete and stable. No changes required to strategy_guard.py or risk_profiles.py.
